info.title: wwg API
info.description: The Wasatch Wargamers Campaign App API.

get.summary: Reports whether the API and its dependencies are healthy.

Every unit in the campaign, sorted by army then name (every member): what the map draws
where it may (positions follow the visibility rule).

post.summary: Adds a unit to the army (Umpire or Admin).

get.summary:
Places matching search (areas and settlements, not addresses), for the
Umpire to frame the map on (Umpire or Admin). 503 if the geocoding service fails.

An army's turns, newest first, with their orders and history (its commander, the Umpire and
Admins: the visibility rule).

post.summary: Creates an account and signs it in.
Signs in with email and password. Repeated failures lock the account briefly.

Swaps the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh cookie (sliding: the 30
days start again). Fails if the cookie is missing, unreadable or expired, or the account is
gone or its security stamp changed (password change, sign out everywhere).

Signs out this browser by removing the refresh cookie. An access token already issued keeps
working until it expires (at most 30 minutes); the app discards it.

Emails a password reset link, if there's an account for the email. Always succeeds, so it
can't be used to find out which emails have accounts.

Sets a new password with the code from a reset link. This signs out every existing session
and clears any sign-in lockout.

put.summary: Updates the signed-in user's first and last name.

Changes the password (the current one is required). Every other session is signed out; the
response carries new tokens so this one keeps working.

Changes the email the account signs in with (the current password is required). Every other
session is signed out, a notice goes to the old address, and the response carries new
tokens so this session keeps working.

post.summary: Signs out every session, this one included: every access and refresh token stops working.

get.summary:
Users, sorted by last then first name, one page at a time. `search` matches any part of
the first name, last name or email, ignoring case.

delete.summary:
Deletes a user and their sign-in data; their sessions end immediately. Admins can't delete
their own account.

get.summary:
Every campaign, sorted by name, one page at a time. `search` matches any part of the
name, ignoring case; `withoutUmpire` keeps only campaigns with no Umpire.

put.summary:
Makes a user the campaign's Umpire. A Player is promoted (and their army left unassigned);
anyone else joins as the Umpire.
The previous Umpire, if there is one, becomes a Player. Choosing the current Umpire changes
nothing.

get.summary: The campaigns the caller is in, with their role, sorted by name.

post.summary: Starts a campaign. The caller becomes its Umpire.

get.summary: A campaign's details: its Umpire (if it has one) and the caller's role.

put.summary: Changes the campaign's name and description (Umpire or Admin).

delete.summary:
Deletes the campaign and everything in it: its members, armies and units (Umpire or
Admin). The database's cascades do the rest.

get.summary: The campaign's current join code (Umpire or Admin).

post.summary:
Replaces the join code, so the old join link stops working (Umpire or Admin). Existing
members stay.

get.summary:
The campaign's members, with the army each Player commands: the Umpire first, then Players
by name.

delete.summary: Leaves the campaign (Players). The Umpire can't leave: an Admin sets a new Umpire instead.
Removes a Player from the campaign (Umpire or Admin).

get.summary: The campaign a join link is for: its name and Umpire. No sign-in needed.

post.summary:
Joins the campaign as a Player: 201. Already a member (including its Umpire): 200 with the
existing role, and nothing changes.

get.summary: The campaign's factions, sorted by name, with how many armies each has.

post.summary: Adds a faction (Umpire or Admin). 409 if the campaign already has one by that name.

put.summary: Renames a faction (Umpire or Admin). 409 if another has that name.

delete.summary:
Deletes a faction (Umpire or Admin). Its armies are kept, unassigned; the Umpire assigns
them to another before the campaign starts.

get.summary:
Every army in the campaign, with its commander, sorted by name. All members see them all,
unassigned ones included.

post.summary:
Adds an army, optionally with a commander and faction (Umpire or Admin). A campaign has at
most 8 armies (409). Without a colour it gets the first one no other army has.

get.summary:
An army's details and units. Every member sees every army's (read-only); where the units
are is a separate question (DESIGN.md §5.2, the visibility rule).

put.summary: Changes an army's name, faction, colour and nation (Umpire or Admin).

delete.summary:
Deletes an army and its units (Umpire or Admin), while the campaign is setting up; after it
starts, that would erase their history (409).

put.summary:
Makes a Player the army's commander, replacing any other (Umpire or Admin). A Player
commands at most one army: 409 if they already command another.

delete.summary: Leaves the army without a commander (Umpire or Admin).

put.summary: Changes a unit's name, type, Fighting Factor and points (Umpire or Admin).

get.summary:
The campaign's map settings (every member): its bounds (null until set), label language,
distance unit, layers and movement limits. Before the Umpire saves any, the defaults.

put.summary:
Changes the campaign's map settings (Umpire or Admin). Bounds run west to east and south to
north; every unit type has a movement limit, once.

get.summary:
The campaign's turns and where each stands (every member). The Umpire sees every army's
turn, and while setting up what stops the campaign starting; a commander sees their own
army's, and everyone the counts.

Where the campaign's units are, as the caller may see them (the visibility rule): the Umpire
every army's, a commander their own. Without turn, where they are now
(each unit's latest Completed turn); with it, their orders in that turn, whatever its status.

post.summary:
Starts the campaign (Umpire or Admin): turn 0 closes, with every army's placements as where
its units are, and turn 1 opens, a Draft for every army. 409 if it has started already, or
with what's stopping it (no area, no armies, an army without a faction, units not placed).

put.summary:
Places a unit on the map (Umpire or Admin): while setting up, in turn 0; once started, a
unit added since that has no position yet (it's placed where its army last was, in the
army's latest Completed turn). Inside the campaign's area, which must be set.

delete.summary: Takes a unit off the map again (Umpire or Admin), while setting up only.

put.summary:
Gives a unit its order for the turn (the army's commander, while the turn is a Draft in
the open campaign turn): Move, inside the campaign's area and within the unit type's limit
of where it is (a straight line); or Hold, where it is. Replaces any order it had.

delete.summary: Takes back a unit's order for the turn (the army's commander, while it's a Draft).

post.summary:
Submits the army's turn for the Umpire to approve (the army's commander): a Draft in the
open turn, once every unit on the map has an order. Nothing changes while it's Submitted.
Approves a Submitted turn in the open turn (Umpire or Admin): it's Completed.

Sends a Submitted turn in the open turn back to its commander as a Draft (Umpire or
Admin), with a note on the turn and on units if wanted.

Reverts a Completed turn in the open turn to a Draft (Umpire or Admin), with a note on the
turn and on units if wanted. Turns in closed campaign turns can't be reverted.

umpireName.description: The Umpire's name, or null if it has none.

AdminCampaignSummary.description: A campaign in the admin list of every campaign.

ArmyColor.description:
An army's colour on the map and beside its name: one of the front-end's 8 palette colours,
which it tunes for contrast in light and dark. Stored by name, so the palette can change.

ArmyFaction.description: The faction an army is in.

oneOf.description: Its commander, or null if unassigned.
Its faction, or null if it has none yet.

nation.description: The nation it fights for, drawn as its flag.

ArmyResponse.description: An army's details, with its units.

oneOf.description: Its commander, or null if unassigned.
Its faction, or null if it has none yet.

nation.description: The nation it fights for, drawn as its flag.

ArmySummary.description: An army in the campaign's army list. Every member sees every army.

id.description: The army turn's ID (orders are given through it).

open.description: Whether it's in the open campaign turn.

orders.description: Its units' orders, and so positions after it.

history.description: What happened to it, oldest first.

ArmyTurnDetails.description: An army's turn, with its orders and history.

byName.description: Who, or null if their account is gone.

note.description: The Umpire's note, when sending back or reverting.

ArmyTurnEventDto.description: One step in an army turn's history.

ArmyTurnEventKind.description: What happened to an army's turn.

ArmyTurnSummary.description: An army's part in a campaign turn.

oneOf.description: The area everyone's map is held inside, or null until the Umpire sets it.

labelLanguage.description: Place names' language: an ISO 639-1 code, or "local".

movementLimits.description: How far each type of unit moves in a turn, one per type.

id.description: The membership's ID (used to remove a Player).

oneOf.description: The army they command, or null.
The Umpire, or null if the campaign has none (their account was deleted).
The caller's role, or null for an Admin who isn't a member.

CampaignRole.description: A campaign role (stored as its name).

CampaignStage.description: Where a campaign is: setting up (turn 0), or running (turn 1 or later is open).

umpireName.description: The Umpire's name, or null if it has none.

CampaignSummary.description: A campaign in the "my campaigns" list.

openTurn.description: The open turn's number (0 while setting up).

turns.description: Every turn so far, oldest first.

startProblems.description: While setting up, for the Umpire: what stops the campaign starting.

closedAt.description: When the next opened (UTC), or null while it's the open turn.

submitted.description: How many armies have submitted (or completed) it.

armies.description: How many armies take part in it.

armyTurns.description: Each army's part: all of them for the Umpire, a commander's own for them.

ChangeEmailRequest.description:
Changes the email the account signs in with. Other sessions are signed out, and a notice goes
to the old address.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Changes the password. Other sessions are signed out; this one continues.

commanderMemberId.description: A Player to command it (their membership ID), or null.

factionId.description: Its faction, or null for none yet ("Unassigned").

oneOf.description: Its colour, or null for the first one no other army has.
The nation it fights for (its flag), or null for none (a plain flag).

CreateArmyRequest.description: Adds an army to the campaign (at most 8).

CreateCampaignRequest.description: Starts a campaign; the caller becomes its Umpire.

name.description: The faction's name, unique in the campaign.

CreateFactionRequest.description: Adds a faction (a side) to the campaign.

type.description: What kind of troops it is.

CreateUnitRequest.description: Adds a unit to an army.

DistanceUnit.description: How distances are shown (they're stored in metres).

armyCount.description: How many armies are in it.

FactionResponse.description: A side in the campaign. Every member sees them all.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Asks for a password reset link by email.

kind.description: Move (to the position) or Hold (stay where it is).

latitude.description: Where to move, in degrees (Move only).

longitude.description: Where to move, in degrees (Move only).

GiveOrderRequest.description: A unit's order for the turn.

myRole.description: The caller's role: Player, or their existing role if already a member.

JoinCampaignResponse.description: The campaign the caller is now in.

joinCode.description: The code, safe to use in a URL as it is.

JoinCodeResponse.description: A campaign's join code. The app builds the join link from it.

umpireName.description: The Umpire's name, or null if the campaign has none.

JoinPreviewResponse.description: What a join link shows before joining. Public: anyone with the code can see it.

LoginRequest.description: Sign in with email and password.

east.description: The eastern edge's longitude (east of West: bounds can't cross 180°).

north.description: The northern edge's latitude (north of South).

MapBounds.description: The area a campaign's map is held inside, in degrees (west to east, south to north).

water.description: Rivers, canals, lakes and the sea.

MapLayers.description: Which of the map's layers are shown.

nation.description: The nation it fights for, drawn as its flag.

email.description: Their email, which is also what they sign in with.

metres.description: The straight-line distance, in metres (up to 1,000 km).

MovementLimitDto.description: How far a unit of one type can move in one turn.

Nation.description:
The nation or state of the Napoleonic wars an army fights for. The front-end draws its flag (a
simplified one) as the army's icon; None is a plain flag in the army's colour. Stored by name.

OrderKind.description: What a unit does in a turn.

items.description: This page's items, in a stable order.

pageSize.description: The requested page size (the last page can have fewer items).

totalCount.description: How many items there are across all pages.

PagedResponseOfAdminCampaignSummary.description: One page of a list that can grow large.

items.description: This page's items, in a stable order.

pageSize.description: The requested page size (the last page can have fewer items).

totalCount.description: How many items there are across all pages.

PagedResponseOfCampaignSummary.description: One page of a list that can grow large.

items.description: This page's items, in a stable order.

pageSize.description: The requested page size (the last page can have fewer items).

totalCount.description: How many items there are across all pages.

PagedResponseOfUserSummary.description: One page of a list that can grow large.

description.description: Its name with where it is ("Leipzig, Saxony, Germany").

oneOf.description: Its extent, if the service knows it.

PlaceResult.description: A place found by a search, to frame the map on.

latitude.description: Latitude, in degrees, inside the campaign's area.

longitude.description: Longitude, in degrees, inside the campaign's area.

PlaceUnitRequest.description: Where the Umpire places a unit.

RegisterRequest.description: Sign up. The account is signed in straight away.

name.description: The faction's new name, unique in the campaign.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Sets a new password with the code from a reset link.

note.description: A note on the turn as a whole.

unitNotes.description: Notes on units in the army, at most one each.

ReviewTurnRequest.description: Why the Umpire sends a turn back or reverts it: a note, and notes on units.

userId.description: The new Umpire: a Player in the campaign, or any other user.

SetUmpireRequest.description: Makes a user the campaign's Umpire.

accessToken.description: The bearer token for API calls.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires; refresh before then.

TokenResponse.description:
A signed-in session. The access token goes in `Authorization: Bearer …`; the refresh
token is never in a body: it's set as an HttpOnly cookie that only /api/auth receives.

UnitNoteDto.description: The Umpire's note on one unit's order.

turn.description: The turn this is its position after.

status.description: That army turn's status (a Draft's positions are orders not yet approved).

kind.description: Its order: Move (or placed, in turn 0) or Hold.

UnitPosition.description: Where a unit is (or is ordered to be) after a turn.

type.description: What kind of troops it is.

UnitType.description: What kind of troops a unit is (stored as its name).

factionId.description: Its faction, or null for none ("Unassigned").

color.description: Its colour. Two armies can share one.

nation.description: The nation it fights for, drawn as its flag.

UpdateArmyRequest.description: Changes an army's name, faction, colour and nation.

oneOf.description: The area everyone's map is held inside, or null for none yet.

labelLanguage.description: Place names' language: an ISO 639-1 code from the list, or "local".

movementLimits.description: How far each type of unit moves in a turn: every type, once.

UpdateCampaignMapRequest.description: Changes a campaign's map settings (all of them).

UpdateCampaignRequest.description: Changes a campaign's name and description.

type.description: What kind of troops it is.

UserCampaign.description: A campaign a user is in.

email.description: Their email (what they sign in with).

lockedOutUntil.description: When a sign-in lockout ends (UTC), if they're locked out now.

campaigns.description: The campaigns they're in, with their role, sorted by name.

UserDetails.description: One user, for admins, with the campaigns they're in.

email.description: Their email (what they sign in with).

UserSummary.description: A user in the admin user list.

Bearer.description: The accessToken from register, login or refresh.
